reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model SE4500. The recalled model is SE4570, so the product is not covered by the recall.
The claimant's typed model also reads SE4500, so it does not match the recalled model either.
The purchase is from a listed retailer (www.grainger.com) within the sale window, and there are no duplicate claims. These facts do not cure the model mismatch.
